Jennifer Bowman

An El Niño info hub for San Diegans

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

San Diego County officials have launched an information hub for what could be one of the strongest El Niño seasons on record.

The online resource allows residents to sign up for emergency alerts, find sandbags, report non-emergency issues in the county’s unincorporated areas and more.

You’ve probably heard by now: A strong El Niño is developing in the tropical Pacific Ocean. So what can San Diegans expect? Check out our explainer.

Related story Super El Niño is coming. What exactly does that mean for San Diego?
